about.name: Ashwin Keshwaram
about.content: Proven Software Engineer with 15+ years of hands-on experience in the US tech industry. Experienced Sitecore (a popular .NET-based CMS) and .NET Developer with 10 years of expertise in developing and implementing Sitecore based solutions and over 15 years in .NET applications. Full-stack versatility with an expertise in backend development (Sitecore, Node.js, .NET, .NET Core, SQL Server) and a solid foundation in frontend technologies (React, JavaScript). Skilled in collaborating with product owners, leadership, and business stakeholders, while mentoring and supporting both in-house and client team developers to enhance their skills.

highlights: Led development for a website with 27 regions, 31 languages, and over $2 trillion in assets under management for a global investment management firm client of S&P Global by utilizing Sitecore 9.3, C#, .NET Framework, SQL Server, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS daily
Created a dashboard to monitor client’s fund data utilizing C#, .NET Core, and .NET Core MVC logic
Implemented custom pipelines to meet unique needs of the project, accommodate custom business logic, and create experiences tailored to different user roles
Developed and maintained PowerShell scripts to automate and streamline Sitecore tasks across multiple language versions, enabling reuse across teams
Created and adjusted SQL Server stored procedures for handling complex data processing tasks
Improved Sitecore practices and mentor other developers on the team on best practices

Led performance improvements by refining caching strategies, optimizing sublayouts/renderings, configuring Solr search indexes, and minimizing redundant SQL stored procedure calls, achieving a 30% increase in response times for high-demand pages
Utilized Grafana and Kibana for real-time monitoring and to identify performance bottlenecks
Developed a public-facing web application for a high-profile fintech client of S&P Global, using React for the frontend, supported by a Node API and SQL Server for the backend
Utilized JUnit for unit testing in Node.js and React applications to ensure 95%+ coverage for each individual feature
Served as the primary point of contact for all Sitecore and .NET related inquiries and issues within the team
Utilized Nomad and Docker to containerize applications
Implemented and maintained Jenkins pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment, integrating SonarQube for continuous code quality analysis, improving code reliability
Conducted thorough code reviews for pull requests, ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices
Wrote code that adheres to Sitecore JSS/Headless architecture using the .NET Framework, C#, Angular, and Typescript for arrow.com
Supported and improved arrow.com including building new Sitecore components to ease the creation of new high traffic and high revenue pages by content editors and marketers
Built and maintained websites for multiples high-profiles clients of Vertic. Created over 100 different web components using Sitecore, C#, .NET MVC, .NET WebForms, and Web API
Managed and optimized the content authoring process within Sitecore Experience Editor for a large number of components
Worked collaboratively with other developers, participate in peer code reviews, and followed best practices and design patterns
Supported cloud-based deployment and management of Sitecore/.NET application environments in Azure

list.location: Somerville, MA, USA & Raleigh, NC, USA
highlights: Built Sitecore applications from scratch using .NET MVC, .NET WebForms, Angular, and Backbone
Upgraded applications to latest versions of Sitecore using express migration tool
Implemented custom workflows for content authors to ensure smooth transition between drafting, review, and publishing
Implemented unit tests using NUnit to ensure code quality and functionality, leading to improved test coverage and reduced bug rates in production
Participated in all phases of the software development of Data Interaction, an online platform for reporting student assessment and performance results at the State, District and School Levels

Designed, implemented, and tested the Analyze module for the application, enabling users to generate customized reports using district/state assessment data, and developed the back end for multiple reports in C# with .NET Web Forms, .NET MVC, and jQuery to allow users to tailor the data displayed
